exposure.needed: which cluster operations fail at runtime and surface the changed error message

consequence.statement: When a cluster-related error occurs, the error message now returns only the cluster URL rather than the full cluster object, so anything reading those messages no longer sees the full cluster object.
consequence.remediation: No operator action is required; only the content of cluster-related error messages changes.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 changes cluster-related error messages to return the cluster URL instead of the full cluster object.
